subject: Minor log fixes when failover auth denied due to slot epoch (#1341)
reason: The change only edits two log message strings in cluster_legacy.c: it renames a variable label in the failover-auth-denied warning and appends the node's config epoch to the election-start notice. The logic (vote denial condition, election start, epoch handling) is unchanged; nodeEpoch(myself) is a pure read used only for formatting. No command reply, replication, failover, or persistence behaviour changes, and log wording is not observable by any oracle, so no scenario is needed.
